info.title: FieldOps API
info.description:
Multi-tenant field service platform API. Source of truth for the frontend
client (orval / openapi-typescript). Backend must emit an equivalent
`openapi.json` from code; diffs go through PR review.

## Conventions
- Tenant comes from the JWT claim `tenant_id`, never from URL or body.
- JSON is camelCase; enums are snake_case strings.
- Instants: ISO 8601 UTC (`2026-10-16T08:00:00Z`). Dates: `2026-10-16`.
  Wall-clock times (working hours, client windows): `HH:mm`, tenant-local.
- Phones: E.164 (`+385911234567`). Server normalises input.
- Money: decimal string (`"12.50"`). Never float.
- Lists: `?page=1&pageSize=50` (max 200), `?sort=field` / `?sort=-field`.
- Errors: `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457); validation errors map
  field path → messages in `errors`.
- Field actions accept `Idempotency-Key`; a replay returns the stored
  response, a replay with a different body returns 422.
- Updates are full replacements (PUT) unless stated otherwise.
  `version` (from Postgres xmin) enables optimistic concurrency → 409.

## Job status machine
| from | allowed to |
|---|---|
| new | scheduled, cancelled |
| scheduled | confirmed, en_route, new, cancelled |
| confirmed | en_route, scheduled, cancelled |
| en_route | on_site, scheduled |
| on_site | completed (only via `/complete`), on_hold |
| on_hold | new, scheduled, cancelled |
| completed | invoiced, new (reopen, owner/dispatcher) |
| invoiced | — |
| cancelled | new (owner/dispatcher) |

## Realtime (SignalR hub `/hubs/dispatch`)
Auth via `?access_token=`. Server adds connection to groups `tenant:{id}`
and, for technicians, `tech:{technicianId}`. Server → client events:
`JobUpdated` (JobUpdatedEvent), `JobStatusChanged` (JobStatusChangedEvent),
`RoutePlanPublished` (RoutePlanPublishedEvent), and for users with sales access `SalesThreadUpdated` (SalesThreadUpdatedEvent), `DealUpdated` (DealUpdatedEvent), `DraftReady` (DraftReadyEvent) in group `sales:{tenantId}`. Clients invalidate
TanStack Query caches on receipt; payloads are intentionally thin.

tags.name: Sales
tags.description: Sales module (plan feature `sales`). Every operation returns 403 with code `sales.not_enabled` when the plan lacks the feature and `sales.forbidden` when the user has no sales access (owners always have it; others need Member.canAccessSales). Personal mailboxes and their threads are visible only to their owner and tenant owners. AI never sends mail and never moves a deal on its own: it classifies, summarises, suggests and drafts. Error codes (ProblemDetails.code): 403 sales.not_enabled, sales.forbidden; 409 sales.mailbox_exists (address already connected), sales.mailbox_needs_reauth, mailbox.cannot_send (canSend false), sales.ai_disabled, thread.not_linked, sales.deal_already_converted, sales.stage_in_use (stage still has deals), sales.stage_required (a tenant always has exactly one active won and one active lost stage); 400 sales.lost_reason_required (validation, also in errors.lostReason); 422 mailbox.imap_failed or mailbox.smtp_failed (detail carries the server message); 429 sales.ai_quota_exceeded with Retry-After when the plan's monthly AI allowance is used up. A conversation that is in several connected mailboxes (e.g. info@ and a personal inbox in CC) is one thread; a user sees the messages from the mailboxes they can see. Push webhooks (/webhooks/gmail, /webhooks/microsoft-graph) are backend-only.

post.description:
Status starts as `new`. `durationMin`, `requiredPeople` and the checklist are
copied from the job type unless overridden. Number allocated from the
tenant sequence. Broadcasts `JobUpdated`.

put.description: Office fields only. Status, assignment and field data have dedicated endpoints. Technicians may only change `internalNote`.

post.description:
Moves the job along the state machine (see top of spec). Writes job_status_history
and fires side effects (e.g. `en_route` → "on the way" SMS if enabled).
`completed` is not allowed here — use `/complete`.

409.description: Transition not allowed from current status

post.description:
Manual assignment (drag & drop). Replaces the assignment set. With a
`scheduledDate`, a `new` job moves to `scheduled`; an empty
`technicianIds` moves a scheduled job back to `new`.

get.summary: The signed-in technician's day, in route order.

put.description: Save draft report fields. Allowed while `on_site` (or by office until `invoiced`).

get.summary: Printable HTML work order (browser → Print → PDF). Stand-in until QuestPDF.

post.description: Upload the signature PNG via `/attachments/upload-url` (kind `signature`), confirm it, then link it here.

Validates (required checklist items, signature if `tenant.settings.requireSignature`,
`workDone` present), sets `completed`, enqueues PDF generation and client email.
The PDF appears on the report as `pdfAttachmentId` when the background job finishes.

post.summary: Confirm a finished S3 upload. Server checks the object exists and size/mime match.
Creates a pending attachment and a presigned S3 PUT URL (valid 10 min).

201.description: Upload with PUT to `uploadUrl`, sending exactly `headers`

post.description:
Builds the VROOM problem (vehicles = technicians, jobs = jobs), calls the
solver and stores the result as a `draft` plan. Locked jobs and
multi-person jobs stay fixed with their current assignee. Synchronous;
expect up to ~10 s. Counts towards `usage.optimizationsCount`.

put.description: Manual corrections to a draft. Server recomputes ETAs only for routes that changed.

post.description:
Applies the plan: assignments, scheduledStart, jobs → `scheduled`. Any
previously published plan for that date becomes `discarded`. Schedules
SMS reminders. Broadcasts `RoutePlanPublished`.

200.description: Plans due within N days, soonest first

put.description: `key`, `entity` and `type` are immutable after creation (existing JSONB values depend on them).

422.description: Tried to change an immutable property

204.description: Deleted (values stay in JSONB but are hidden)

post.summary: CSV import, upsert by SKU.
Render a template body against a job (or sample data) and show SMS segment count.

bearerAuth.description: Access token, ~15 min. Claims: sub, tenant_id, role, technician_id (if technician).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated UUID per user action. Replays within 24 h return the original response.

Forbidden.description: Role does not allow this action

NotFound.description: Not found (also returned for other tenants' resources)

Conflict.description: Conflict (stale version, duplicate, or invalid state)

CustomFieldValues.description: key → value, validated against CustomFieldDefinition. Sensitive fields are returned only to owners/dispatchers and assigned technicians; otherwise omitted.

code.description: Stable machine code for the frontend, e.g. `job.invalid_transition`, `job.signature_required`

technicianId.description: Set when the user is a technician in the active tenant

canAccessSales.description: True when the plan has the `sales` feature and the user is an owner or has the membership permission. Drives the Prodaja menu.

inviteUrl.description: Only when the server has no SMTP configured, so the office can pass the link on by hand.

jobs.description: In visit order; each includes location/contact data needed offline-ish on the phone

lat.description: From Places autocomplete; if absent, geocoded in background

accessCodes.description: Secret (alarm/gate codes). Write-only: null = keep stored value, "" = remove, text = replace. Encrypted at rest (AES-GCM); read back via Location.accessCodes only by allowed roles.
Only for owner/dispatcher and technicians assigned to an open job here (access is audit-logged). Otherwise omitted.

JobSummary.description: Row shape for lists, calendar and dispatch board cards.

clientDetail.description: Full client with contacts (detail view and technician day)

allowedTransitions.description: Transitions the current user may perform now — drive buttons from this, not from client-side rules.

sequence.description: Position in the lead technician's day (board ordering)

plannedMinutes.description: Sum of job durations + travel if a plan exists

unassigned.description: Status new (any date) + scheduled for this date without technicians

detail.description: Human-readable, e.g. "Nijedan monter nema vještinu: video nadzor"

isDefault.description: Platform default, not yet customised by tenant

PublicJob.description: Deliberately minimal — no client PII beyond first name, no access codes.

estimatedDurationMin.description: Average planned durationMin — compare against actual

scheduledDate.description: Lets the board decide whether to refetch

MailProvider.description: gmail = Google Workspace / Gmail API, microsoft = Microsoft 365 via Graph, imap = any other host (IMAP + SMTP)

MailboxKind.description: shared (e.g. info@) is visible to everyone with sales access; personal only to its owner and tenant owners

ThreadCategory.description: Sales categories: new_inquiry … declined. Non-sales: support (complaints, service for existing work), admin (invoices, suppliers, bank), spam, other.

AiStatus.description: skipped = AI disabled, excluded sender, or plan without AI

SalesStageKind.description: Exactly one active stage of kind won and one of kind lost per tenant

TodayReason.description: follow_up_due: our last message got no reply within the rule; unanswered: client wrote and nobody answered within the SLA; stale: no activity for the stage limit

request.description: What the client wants, one or two sentences

ExtractedContact.description: Data the AI pulled out of the conversation. Never applied automatically; the UI offers it when creating a client or job.

confidence.description: Null when set by a user

summary.description: One sentence, in the tenant language

nextAction.description: Suggested next step, e.g. "Pošalji ponudu do petka"

lastError.description: Human-readable reason when status is error or needs_reauth

syncFrom.description: Mail older than this date is never imported

canSend.description: False when the grant lacks send/draft permission

MailboxUpdate.description: syncFrom can only be set when connecting

ownerUserId.description: Required for personal mailboxes; defaults to the caller

mailboxId.description: Set to re-authorise an existing mailbox (status needs_reauth)

password.description: App password. Encrypted at rest, never returned.

partId.description: Provider attachment id within the message

savedAttachmentId.description: Set once saved to a deal

bodyText.description: Plain text with quoted history stripped. Null when the body is not stored (non-sales thread under the retention rules).

mailbox.description: Mailbox the thread is shown under. When the same conversation is in several mailboxes (info@ and a personal inbox in CC) it is one thread; a shared mailbox is preferred here.

awaitingReply.description: Last message is inbound and unanswered

needsReview.description: AI confidence below the review threshold and no user correction yet

client.description: Existing client matched by email or phone

mailboxes.description: Every mailbox the user can see that contains this thread; drafts can be sent from any of them. Messages that exist only in mailboxes the user can't see (e.g. someone else's personal inbox) are not included in messages.

ClassificationUpdate.description: User correction. Stored as feedback and used as an example for future classification in this tenant.

dealId.description: Link to an existing deal; null with no createDeal unlinks

ThreadLinkRequest.description: Send exactly one of dealId or createDeal, or dealId: null to unlink.

pattern.description: Email address or "@domain". Defaults to the thread's external sender.

purge.description: Delete stored bodies and classification of matching threads

followUpDays.description: Default days without a client reply before a follow-up is due in this stage

staleAfterDays.description: Days without any activity before the deal shows as stale

stageIds.description: All stage ids in the new order

awaitingReply.description: The client wrote last and nobody answered

stageId.description: Defaults to the first open stage

DealUpdate.description: Stage changes go through /move, not here.

extracted.description: Merged from the linked threads, newest first

lostReason.description: Required when the target stage is of kind lost

locationId.description: Existing location of clientId; with newClient, firstLocation is used

DealConvertRequest.description: Creates (or reuses) the client and location and a job in status new, in one transaction. Attachments saved to the deal are copied to the job.

text.description: Note text or a short description

data.description: Type-specific details, e.g. {fromStageId, toStageId} or {threadId, messageId}

SalesBoard.description: Open stages in order, then won and lost. Won/lost columns hold only the last 30 days.

instructions.description: Extra guidance, e.g. "ponudi termin u utorak, cijena 1.200 €"

mailboxId.description: Send from this mailbox; must be one of MailThread.mailboxes (else 400). Default: the thread's mailbox.

draft.description: Prepared follow-up or reply, when the rule creates one

items.description: Overdue first, then by due time

replyLanguage.description: "auto" (reply in the client's language) or a BCP-47 tag

knowledge.description: Services, prices, terms, typical lead times. The only business facts drafts may use.

storeNonSalesBodies.description: When false, only metadata is kept for threads classified as non-sales

retentionDays.description: Delete bodies of threads with no activity for this long; null = keep

daysWithoutReply.description: Business days after our last outbound message with no client reply

createDraft.description: Prepare an AI follow-up draft when the rule fires

winRate.description: won / (won + lost); null when nothing closed
